0022600220.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak and 14th in the East) host the San Antonio Spurs (9-2, on a nine-game winning streak and 1st in the Southwest) in the Bulls' 10th game of the season, with Chicago at home 0-3 and San Antonio 5-0 on the road. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost 0-2, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30. Chicago will be without Norman Powell (day-to-day, shoulder inflammation) and Zach Collins (day-to-day, illness), both game-time decisions, while San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain), and Devin Vassell is a game-time decision (day-to-day, groin).
